warm: file read once before the clock
cold: drop_caches after warmup, before the timed read
notes: OVITO 3.17.2 reads extended XYZ periodicity and an out-of-cell second frame without wrapping or repeating frame 0.

mdcompress 1.0.0 is not on PyPI and conda is not installed. apt has no libxdrfile. CC=gcc CXX=g++ make mdcompress links bin/mdcompress; it prints version 2.0.5, not 1.0.0. gcc accepts -fabi-version=6, which is the flag clang rejected. The coordinate-only row stays omitted rather than labeling 2.0.5 as 1.0.0.
readcon 1M CON write serial 0.0639s, default threads 0.0487s, same bytes, warmup 1 samples 6
chemfiles has no native CON format; the chemfiles-con row copies positions and the cell out of a chemfiles Frame filled from readcon.
chemfiles compression library /tmp/chemfiles-install/lib/libchemfiles.so opens {"bz2": true, "gz": true, "trr": true, "xz": true}
MDAnalysis 2.11.0 on DCD, XTC, NetCDF, TRR, XYZ and PDB. Cells are orthogonal, so the 2.11 triclinic wrap does not apply.
The run's git rev-parse was 5b7dff6063b12641fafd330c461267ba68f6b891. That commit is d45b852d59cb2c330431cfdabf00aab7fd173317 after the rebase onto 7216d202. The measured sources are unchanged.
